pb-va.title: Virtual assistant
pb-va.intro: Keep client requests, private routines and manual purchases together. You approve every outside action.
pb-va.priceHelp: Use the exact owner-agreed price in paise. The engine computes the total and receipt.
pb-va.payManual: Chausar never types payment details. Pay it yourself.
pb-va.notBought: Nothing was bought. Check this item and total, then buy it yourself.
pb-va.rule: Whole quantity multiplied by the exact unit price in minor units.
pb-va.routineHelp: Saved mail, monitor status and Today records only. No model call. Each scheduled report waits for approval on Today.
pb-va.error: This action could not be completed. Read the current details and try again.
pb-va.promptMorning: Read the saved mail, monitor status and Today records. Quote each line with its source. Keep this report private.
pb-va.promptWeekly: Read this week saved mail, monitor status and Today records. Quote each line with its source. Keep this report private.
